root_cause: accounts_service_runner spawned [sys.executable, '-m', 'accounts_service.main']; in a frozen build sys.executable is Atlas.exe (not Python), and atlas.spec excluded fastapi/uvicorn/starlette and never bundled accounts_service or its vendored deps. The accounts service therefore never started, so :8788 was never reachable.
architecture_detail: AtlasAccounts.exe (its own PyInstaller one-folder bundle with FastAPI/uvicorn/pydantic/sqlalchemy/bcrypt) ships inside the Atlas install folder under accounts/. Atlas.exe's runner spawns it in frozen mode. Two-process HTTP architecture preserved.
files_bundled: dist/Atlas/accounts/AtlasAccounts.exe (+ _internal: fastapi, uvicorn, starlette, pydantic, pydantic_core, sqlalchemy, greenlet, bcrypt, passlib, jwt, email_validator, anyio, h11, click)
files_changed: packaging/pyinstaller/atlas.spec (unchanged excludes; desktop bundle stays lean)
startup_sequence: frozen runner spawns accounts/AtlasAccounts.exe with a writable data dir
desktop register/login/onboarding call the service over HTTP

integration_verification.method: scripts/verify_frozen_accounts.ps1 — clean silent install, launch only Atlas.exe

overhead.note: Some non-runtime weight (mypy plugin via pydantic, vendored test dirs) could be trimmed later; out of scope for the blocker fix.
